feature.title: One Look for the App and the Cockpit

notes: The maintainer asked for design research, a switchable mock, and this hub on a branch. Design acceptance and implementation scope remain open; no application, Linear, deployment, or transaction work is authorized.

Stated direction: unify look and feel and shared elements across the installed app and the steward cockpit with some variance per surface; no layout or structure change; track the work under the Cosmo-Local project.

Stated preferences awaiting confirmation against rendered pairs: the app's equal-width tabs, the app's filter button, a gap in the cockpit's card list, a wide desktop work card that keeps its image grid, one count badge, a clearer dark card in the cockpit, the cockpit's light mode on the app.
Thirteen forks (F1 to F13) are recommendations, not accepted design specifications. A preset chosen in the design lab is not an acceptance decision.
artifacts/design-lab.html is a hand-built mock drawn from token values; artifacts/captures are Storybook evidence from the deployed build, not authenticated-session proof.
The garden-scoped Home and its switcher stay with the pwa-interface-simplification hub; only the shared look of the garden chip is in scope here.
No implementation lane is certified by document validation.

tdd.note: Token and style steps prove themselves with rendered pairs and the design guards; steps that change a component's structure (tabs, the filter control, the work card) need focused RED/GREEN proof. No implementation or test evidence is recorded by this planning task.

ui.blocked_reason: Design review: the forks in spec.md await the maintainer's decisions, a bounded first slice, and explicit execution authorization.
